purpose: Acceptance matrix for the original Smriti benchmark/cost/growth request and the current ROADMAP. This is an evidence audit, not a completion or release claim.

overall.reason: The installed Mira scope/temporal review rejected the quality pass, and full-history LongMemEval/LoCoMo QA plus larger LME and GBrain semantic QA remain unfinished. The bounded Smriti LoCoMo50 preflight is complete but exploratory and has a known judge/date caveat.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Harden the implementation and prove clean non-editable wheel/source installation, dependency consistency, and CI coverage.
evidence: audit/2026-09-05/raw/benchmark-wheel-verification.json (202 tests, CLI help, packaged GBrain worker, source/wheel match)
audit/2026-09-05/raw/installed-scope-candidate-261.json (261 tests, pip check clean; offline scope checks)
audit/2026-09-05/raw/ci-b107749.json (enterprise and offline Python 3.9/3.12 checks all SUCCESS)
acceptance_matrix.caveat: ROADMAP Phase 1 is reopened because model-backed Mira quality and temporal follow-up are not accepted.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Pass the named-Mira temporal, identity, and applicability-scope contract with a fresh installed model-backed run.
evidence: audit/2026-09-05/raw/smriti-mira-root-review.json (Berlin fact invalidated by unrelated same-date event; scope/transition probe issue)
audit/2026-09-05/raw/smriti-mira-contract-v3-independent-review.json (third party rewritten as user; Atlas scope leaked to light preference; event date encoded as scope)
audit/2026-09-05/raw/installed-scope-candidate-261.json (offline checks accepted; model-backed gate remains open)

audit/2026-09-05/smriti-mira-full-scoped-contract-v4.json (terminal model-backed run; all extracted subjects are Mira, light-mode scope is unscoped, and current Rust/Atlas retrieval is correct, but brittle uses_tool/Aurora assertions fail and unsupported inferred primary Python remains)
acceptance_matrix.remaining: The v4 runtime is terminal but not accepted. Correct the temporal/consolidation and extraction identity/scope behavior, then rerun from a fresh installed wheel with assertions aligned to supported predicates.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Measure Smriti and local Mem0 over the same nomic 768-dimensional route at 100, 1,000, 3,000, 9,000, and 36,500 documents with durable timing, storage, restart/reopen, resubmission, and relevance evidence.
evidence: audit/2026-09-05/raw/growth-independent-final-validation.json (100 warm queries and 500 independently topic-relevant hits per track)
acceptance_matrix.caveat: These are bounded corpus-growth simulations; 30/90/365-day labels are 100-adds/day corpus equivalents, not elapsed longitudinal observations.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Benchmark persistent official-engine GBrain import/search without per-document CLI startup, and keep default untuned and ANALYZE-maintained observations separate.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: GBrain lexical has no embedding API cost and is not a semantic parity result.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Provide a separate real nomic GBrain semantic route with measured 768-dimensional vectors, metadata/vector-count validation, process-restart cold timing, and the same growth checkpoints.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: This does not close model-backed answer-quality evaluation; larger GBrain semantic QA remains pending.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Report measured cumulative ingest/query/storage observations and explicit 30/90/365-day cost scenarios, with local API $0 separated from unmeasured hardware cost and managed Mem0 pricing.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: The report explicitly says local model/API cost is shared by all tested local routes and hardware/electricity/operator costs were not measured.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Render readable standard-matplotlib latency and storage curves for the matched/semantic tracks without inventing missing checkpoints.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: p50/p95 labels identify the empirical nearest-rank method; semantic GBrain and lexical GBrain remain distinct.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Record first query after ingest, cold reopen/restart boundary, warm p50/p95 sample counts, update/resubmit time, storage sidecars/cache, returned IDs/relevance, and model call/token/failure accounting without mocks.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: Smriti/Mem0 cold timing is a same-process client/database reopen; GBrain cold timing is a worker process restart.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Run a same-ID, same-dataset, same-embedder paired public retrieval comparison with failure-inclusive denominators.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: Smriti and Mem0 each completed 48/50; the result is explicitly exploratory and does not support superiority.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Run a bounded same-reader/judge LongMemEval answer/judge preflight.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: Six questions only; Smriti 4/6 and Mem0 3/6, with heuristic abstention scoring.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Complete the bounded 50-question Smriti LoCoMo answer/judge preflight from the installed candidate with failure-inclusive accounting and preserved provenance.
evidence: audit/2026-09-05/locomo-qa-smriti-s50.json (50/50 complete; 0 failures and 0 cleanup failures; 27/50 recorded correct; 21/40 answerable and 6/10 abstention rows correct; 10 sources)
audit/2026-09-05/raw/locomo-smriti-s50-failure-analysis.json (7 retrieved-supported reader failures, 11 missing-evidence failures, 1 ambiguous; official results unmodified)
acceptance_matrix.caveat: The recorded 54%/52.5%/60% figures are exploratory, not a quality headline: the independent review preserves a known judge false-positive date case (conv-30-q0), and the paired Mem0 run is pending.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Run full-history LongMemEval and LoCoMo with one shared answer/judge configuration, plus the requested larger LME and GBrain semantic QA.
evidence: audit/2026-09-05/ROADMAP.md (Phase 2 full QA checkbox remains open)
audit/2026-09-05/locomo-qa-smriti-s50.json (bounded Smriti50 complete; not full-haystack comparative QA)
audit/2026-09-05/raw/locomo-smriti-s50-independent-review.json (counts verified; comparison limit says matched Mem0 pending)
audit/2026-09-05/benchmark-longmemeval-oracle-smriti.json (500-question oracle retrieval only; not full-haystack QA)
acceptance_matrix.remaining: Finish the paired Mem0 LoCoMo preflight, larger LongMemEval QA, GBrain semantic QA, and full-history model-backed QA; retain failure-inclusive raw outputs and do not substitute oracle runs.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Deliver and verify the exact 30-second launch teaser.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: The film is explicitly free of accuracy or speed-superiority claims.

acceptance_matrix.requirement: Keep ROADMAP and reports aligned with measured evidence, explicit caveats, and open quality gates.
acceptance_matrix.caveat: ROADMAP still correctly marks Phase 1 reopened and Phase 2 in progress; this audit does not close either gate.

real_pending_build_work.item: Temporal/consolidation and extraction identity/scope correction followed by a fresh installed model-backed Mira rerun
No additional benchmark adapter, cost report, chart, or teaser build task is evidenced by the current scope; remaining LoCoMo/LME/GBrain work is evaluation execution and validation.

running_or_pending_evaluations: LoCoMo50 installed-v4 Smriti answer/judge run: complete 50/50, 0 operational failures; exploratory result only because of the preserved judge/date caveat and pending paired Mem0 run.

Installed v6 extraction-generalization probe: terminal with failures; distinct subjects/cities and scope checks pass, but the historical scoped-transition assertion is false, so no acceptance claim is made (audit/2026-09-05/extraction-generalization-installed-v6.json).

Fresh installed model-backed Mira scope/temporal acceptance: v4 runtime terminal with failures; all extracted subjects are Mira and Rust/Atlas plus unscoped light mode are present, but brittle uses_tool/Aurora assertions fail and inferred primary Python remains unsupported; acceptance is open.
explicit_nonclaims: The oracle LongMemEval retrieval files are not full-haystack answer quality.
The six-question preflight is not a leaderboard or significance result.
Local API cost $0 is shared across tested local routes and is not hardware cost $0.
Growth day labels are corpus equivalents at 100 adds/day, not calendar observations.
No universal Smriti superiority, zero-defect, or live-deployment claim is supported.
